comment: The module is modelled at circuit level: the sliders, the range switches and the CV are combined through simulated resistor networks (ENVVCACore.cc:65-84 and ENVVCACore.cc:174-195), so the rise and fall times are not a plain mapping from the slider position and no millisecond figures are stated here. The VCA's maximum gain is set by a constant the source says was tuned by hand to about 0dB (ENVVCACore.cc:134-137). The CYCLE jack does not simply switch cycling on: ENVVCACore.cc:87 exclusive-ors it with the button.
